title: The gold / copper ratio as a fear gauge for spot gold

rule.ratio: Q = ln(gold close / copper close) on matched UTC days (weekends folded)
rule.extreme: new 20-row high / low of Q; gold's own extreme = close beyond its 19 previous closes
rule.entry: next gold daily open, held 5 candles, stop 2 x ATR(20), one position at a time
rule.baseline: same side on every eligible day of the window (overlapping), mean net R
rule.costs: $0.60 a round trip + nights() x FIN.xau.long on buys

tests.what: gold / copper ratio at a new 20-row high: buy gold for 5 candles (primary)
gold / copper ratio at a new 20-row low: sell gold for 5 candles
ratio extreme while gold is not at its own 20-day extreme the same way: gold the ratio's way for 5 candles
